claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Phenprobamate is a centrally acting carbamate muscle relaxant with sedative properties; at 2.5 uM over 5 days it is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, with any antiproliferative effect being weak and non-selective rather than a specific killing mechanism.
